evidence: Quick Design-only frontend engineering review of specs/spec.md, design/design.md, and design/contract.json. The proposed work is synchronous Python governance, evidence, Git-checkout, and terminal-projection infrastructure; it introduces no browser UI, component/state model, client data flow, render or interaction path, web asset, bundle change, Core Web Vitals exposure, or new web-platform API. Frontend implementation concerns therefore do not apply to this provisional Design.
